BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE course_plan_request ADD COLUMN diagnostic_plan_id uuid NULL;
ALTER TABLE course_plan_request ADD CONSTRAINT fk_course_plan_diagnostic_plan FOREIGN KEY(diagnostic_plan_id) REFERENCES diagnostic_assessment_plan(id);
ALTER TABLE course_plan_request ADD CONSTRAINT ck_course_plan_diagnostic_link_teacher_initial CHECK (diagnostic_plan_id IS NULL OR (intent_json->>'source'='TEACHER' AND intent_json->>'reason'='INITIAL'));
CREATE INDEX idx_course_plan_diagnostic_plan_id ON course_plan_request(diagnostic_plan_id) WHERE diagnostic_plan_id IS NOT NULL;
COMMIT;
